subject: spaceGalley
pitch:
Category: Prop group.
Subject: spaceship galley kitchen.
Style: Alien (1979) Nostromo.

spec.name: Nostromo Galley
spec.description: A cramped, grimy 1979 industrial-spaceship galley kitchen: a steel counter run with hob, sink and cabinets, a wall of pipes and lockers, and a bolted central mess table with stools, lit by sodium-yellow panel lights and green CRT readouts.
spec.layout: Static prop group, no rig. A rectangular room corner with the viewer at +Z. Back wall at z=-1.5 carries the pipe and locker wall. A steel counter run with hob, sink and cabinets lines the left wall (+X) from z=-1.4 to 1.2. A round-edged bolted mess table with four stools stands in the centre-front. A ceiling and floor rig supplies grated deck, ribbed ceiling beams and light panels. Style: Alien 1979 used-future; off-white and grey-beige panels, dirty steel, black rubber, sodium yellow and orange warning trim, tiny green and amber CRT readouts, dense greebles of pipes, bolts, knobs, stencilled labels, grime streaks. Every piece is a blocky primitive with bolts, seams and trim as separate small parts.

parts.builds: Room shell: grated floor deck with plate seams and bolt rows, back and left wall panels in beige with seam lines and bolt heads, yellow-black warning stripe kick strips, ribbed ceiling with beams, four sodium light panels with dark frames, vent grille, door frame on the right with hazard trim and a green-lit label plate, grime streak patches.
parts.attaches: Floor at floorTop, walls at backWallFace and leftWallFace, ceiling at ceilingUnder; other parts stand on the floor and touch the walls.

parts.builds: Left-wall counter: base cabinets with panel doors, recessed handles, kick plinth, stainless worktop with raised lip, a two-ring hob with knobs and a pot rack, deep sink with tap and drain, a small microwave-like oven with CRT readout, spice racks and clamped storage canisters, stencilled labels and bolts.
parts.attaches: Rests on floorTop against leftWallFace; worktop at counterTop.

parts.builds: Back wall greeble: banks of locker doors with latches and number stencils, a tall fridge-freezer with handle and amber status light, overhead horizontal and vertical pipe runs in copper and grey with flanges, valve wheels, gauge dials, a wall control panel with green CRT screens, toggle switches, red warning labels, cable bundles.
parts.attaches: Mounted flush at backWallFace, base on floorTop, pipes reach the ceilingUnder.

parts.builds: Central mess table and seating: rounded rectangular steel-edged table with beige top, bolted pedestal and floor flange, a tray set (trays, mugs, cutlery blocks, a food pouch pile, a salt shaker), four swivel stools with vinyl seats, rubber rim and chrome posts, a hanging overhead lamp with yellow shade.
parts.attaches: Stands on floorTop, tabletop at tableTop, lamp hangs toward ceilingUnder.
